summary.goal: Spawn a revision agent when orchestrator sends a change request, to help revise the plan
summary.context: When the orchestrator discovers issues during execution (missing steps, wrong dependencies), it sends a ChangeRequest. Currently the UI just displays these. With relay, a revision agent can be spawned to analyze the change request and draft suggested revisions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Change request receipt triggers revision agent spawn
Revision agent receives change request context
Agent drafts plan revisions addressing the request
Human reviews and approves/rejects agent suggestions
Approved changes create new version linked to change request
Fallback to manual revision when relay unavailable

steps.title: Define revision agent system prompt
steps.description: Create src/relay/prompts/revision-agent.ts with system prompt for handling change requests. Include: understand the change request, analyze current plan, suggest minimal changes to address the issue.

acceptance_criteria.description: System prompt defines revision agent role
Prompt includes change request analysis instructions
Prompt emphasizes minimal, targeted changes

steps.title: Create revision agent spawner
steps.description: Create spawnRevisionAgent(planId, changeRequest) in src/relay/spawner.ts. Similar to planning agent but with revision-specific prompt and change request context.

acceptance_criteria.description: spawnRevisionAgent(planId, changeRequest) spawns revision agent
Agent receives: change_request_id, reason, suggested_changes, current plan state
Returns { agentId, sessionToken, sessionId }

steps.title: Trigger revision agent on change request
steps.description: Modify change request handler: when change request received (POST /runs/:run_id/change-requests) and relay available, spawn revision agent.

acceptance_criteria.description: Change request creation triggers revision agent spawn
Change request record stores revision_session_id
Falls back to no agent when relay unavailable (manual revision)
Spawn errors logged but don't fail change request creation

steps.title: Agent creates draft revision
steps.description: Revision agent reads current plan, analyzes change request, uses MCP tools to create new draft version with suggested changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Agent creates new draft version via create_version MCP tool
Changes address the change request reason
Agent marks its changes with revision_source: 'agent'
Agent terminates after creating draft

steps.title: Link revision to change request
steps.description: New version created by revision agent is linked to the change request (result_version_id field). Change request status updated to 'revision_drafted'.

acceptance_criteria.description: Version linked to change request via result_version_id
Change request status updated to 'revision_drafted'
Version metadata includes { change_request_id, revision_source: 'agent' }

steps.title: Add revision status to change request API
steps.description: Enhance GET /plans/:id/change-requests to include revision agent status and linked draft version.

acceptance_criteria.description: Response includes: revision_session_id, revision_status, result_version_id
revision_status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'drafted' | 'none'

steps.title: Update UI to show revision status
steps.description: Enhance ChangeRequestCard to show revision agent status: 'AI analyzing...', 'Draft ready for review', or 'Manual revision needed'.

acceptance_criteria.description: Card shows 'AI analyzing...' with spinner when revision_status='in_progress'
Card shows 'Draft ready' with link when revision_status='drafted'
Card shows 'Manual revision needed' when revision_status='none'

steps.title: Human review flow for agent revisions
steps.description: UI shows revision agent's suggested changes in diff view. Human can accept (keep version), reject (discard version and mark for manual revision), or edit further.

acceptance_criteria.description: Diff view shows changes between current approved and agent draft
Accept button approves the draft version
Reject button discards draft, sets change request back to pending
Edit button navigates to plan editor with draft version
accept-revision: sets draft to approved, updates change request status
reject-revision: discards draft version, resets change request to pending
Both endpoints terminate any active revision session

steps.title: Add tests for change request agent flow
steps.description: Test revision agent lifecycle: spawn on change request, draft creation, human review, accept/reject.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests for revision agent spawning with mocked relay
Tests for draft version linking
Tests for accept/reject flows
Tests for fallback when relay unavailable
